review_candidates.title: Application Support Analyst
review_candidates.description: Job Description Application Support Analyst The Application Support Analyst will be dedicated to Capital Markets initiatives, aligned with the desk, and responsible for ensuring stability, resiliency, and seamless execution of deal-related applications used in Primary Markets (New Issue / Syndication). This role partners closely with syndicate, origination, sales, operations, and technology teams to deliver timely production support, issue resolution, and workflow improvements for business-critical deal execution platforms. The candidate is expected to have strong business knowledge of capital markets processes, excellent troubleshooting ability, and the communication skills needed to interact with front-office stakeholders under time-sensitive conditions. They act as the first line of defense for application stability, ensuring issues are identified, escalated, and resolved efficiently, while also contributing to enhancements and user adoption of the platform. Responsibilities Include Provide dedicated desk-aligned application support for Primary Markets deal execution and syndication applications. Partner with syndicate desk, sales, organization and operations teams to support live deal execution in a high-pressure environment. Proactively monitor critical trade execution workflows to ensure timely identification and resolution of production issues. Triage, investigate, and resolve application incidents; escalate to development teams where required, ensuring minimal disruption to business. Collaborate with business stakeholders to capture issues, requirements, and feedback, aligning them with support and enhancement priorities. Coordinate with technology teams to deliver application fixes, patches, and upgrades. Provide end-user training and knowledge transfer sessions to ensure effective adoption and smooth desk operations. Maintain strong documentation of processes, incident logs, and resolution steps for knowledge reuse. Support release testing, business validation, and readiness for new features and workflows. Serve as a trusted technology partner to the desk, helping optimize deal execution efficiency and application usage. Application Runtime Support (.NET / Java) Support runtime environments for applications built on .NET or Java, including logs, configurations, performance tuning, and JVM/.NET CLR environment understanding. Assist during release deployments, troubleshooting environmental issues impacting banking services. Ensure smooth integration of applications with infrastructure components such as caching, web servers, and databases. Operational Excellence & Monitoring Implement monitoring and alerting using enterprise-grade tools (e.g., AppDynamics, Splunk, Dynatrace, SiteScope). Analyze incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement preventive measures. Maintain infrastructure documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles, and DR runbooks. Qualifications Knowledge and hands-on experience with Capital Markets / Primary Markets deal execution is strongly required (5+ years preferable). Strong understanding of New Issue, Book Building, and Syndication workflows in Fixed Income and Equities. Prior experience providing desk-aligned production support in a trading floor or capital markets environment. Excellent troubleshooting skills; ability to resolve critical production issues quickly under pressure. Strong communication and relationship-building skills; able to interact confidently with front-office users. Knowledge of bond fundamentals and capital markets execution processes is mandatory. Ability to document workflows, create knowledge repositories, and provide effective training. Highly organized, detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple issues and requests simultaneously. Prior experience with vendor platforms for deal execution (e.g., Ipreo / Primary Portal / Dealogic) is a plus Salary Range- $95,000-$120,000 a year

Partnering with a global leader with over 150 years of experience, the company delivers high-quality commercial and residential floor coverings that are environmentally friendly, functional, and design-oriented. Forbo flooring systems are closely integrated into daily life, shaping how people experience spaces at home, at work, and in public areas. Through this partnership, City Floor Decoration provides advanced surface and flooring solutions that support efficient movement of people and goods while enhancing the overall quality of life for end users. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Senior Sales Engineer role based in New Cairo. The Senior Sales Engineer will identify and develop new business opportunities, manage key accounts, and promote Forbo flooring solutions to commercial and residential clients. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting client meetings and site visits, preparing technical proposals and quotations, and delivering product presentations and demonstrations. The role involves providing technical guidance on product selection and installation, coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely project delivery, and supporting customers with post-sale technical inquiries. The Senior Sales Engineer will also monitor market trends, contribute to sales forecasts, and maintain accurate records in the CRM system. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills to understand client requirements, design suitable solutions, and provide reliable technical guidance. Candidates should possess effective Sales capabilities, including lead generation, pipeline management, negotiation, and closing deals in a competitive market. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with proficiency in MS Office and basic CRM tools. Ability to work on-site in New Cairo, visit customer locations, and manage multiple projects and deadlines.

review_candidates.title: Staff Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: As vCluster Labs’ Staff Software Engineer , you will operate as a specialized technical leader, working directly with the CTO to explore new frontiers in our technology. You will bridge the gap between rapid prototyping, architectural research, and product evolution, taking on responsibilities that go far beyond standard coding to shape the future of our Kubernetes virtualization platform. As a Staff Software Engineer, Your Role Will Include: Rapid Prototyping & Innovation: Act as a specialized engineer who identifies interesting product opportunities, researches solutions, and quickly builds prototypes to validate if they work. You will report back on feasibility and guide the technical direction based on your findings. Strategic Technical Leadership: Take ownership of responsibilities beyond coding, including managing complex technical projects, writing technical abstracts, and helping the wider engineering team navigate difficult challenges. Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Work directly with the CTO and operate outside the traditional engineering organization boundaries to solve high-level problems and ideate on new product capabilities. System Mastery & Evolution: Develop a deep understanding of our existing system while maintaining the agility to learn new things quickly. You will be responsible for integrating new technologies into our stack efficiently. Customer & External Engagement: While primarily technical, this role includes customer-facing elements. You will occasionally engage with users to understand their deep technical needs and translate those into engineering solutions. This role could be a fit for you if you bring: Deep Kubernetes & GoLang Expertise: You possess 3+ years of deep technical experience with Kubernetes and GoLang. You are comfortable diving into the internals of cloud-native infrastructure. High Autonomy: You are a self-starter who can work on your own, figure out complex issues without hand-holding, and thrive in an environment where you are trusted to manage your own time and priorities. Beyond the Code: You have experience that extends beyond just writing software. You understand the broader picture of product development, project management, and technical communication. Rapid Learning Agility: You are quick to prototype and even quicker to learn. You enjoy the challenge of picking up new tools, languages, or architectural concepts on the fly to solve immediate problems. Bonus Points For: Deep understanding of cloud-native containers and the broader ecosystem. Startup experience where you had significant technical influence and helped shape the product. Experience writing technical content, such as abstracts, white papers, or blog posts. Background in Platform Engineering or experience building internal developer platforms (IDPs). About VCluster Labs We are a venture-backed tech startup striving to be the leading force in enabling platform engineers. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture. We are vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (+10k GitHub stars). Open source is part of our DNA. The adoption of our commercial product based on vCluster has grown extremely fast (multi-million dollar revenue) and our customer base includes some of the biggest companies in the world, including 6 Global Fortune 500 companies as well as some of the fastest-growing tech unicorns and AI clouds (neoclouds). Why join vCluster Labs? Since We Are a Fast-moving Startup, You Will Not Be Number 14,589 In Our Company But Rather Become An Essential Part Of Our Team Right From The Start: Fast Application Process: We will typically get back to you within a week. No need to polish your resume for us. Just send us some links (e.g. LinkedIn, etc.), answer a few questions about your previous experiences, and hop on a quick Zoom call with one of our team members to see if you’re a good fit. We will respond quickly and make hiring decisions within days rather than months. Open-Minded Work Environment: You can always speak your mind - no company politics or unnecessary formalities. We are operating in a lean, honest, and efficient way and we are looking for different perspectives, constructive feedback and creative, motivated people who want to make a difference. Grow With The Company: We are a small company right now but we are growing incredibly fast because we work on something that has a lot of value to engineering teams in large enterprises. Joining vCluster Labs early will give you the chance to advance much faster to the next step on the career ladder than in any larger company. Responsibility From Day 1: You will see right from the start that your work will immediately have an impact in our company and you can shape the future of this company together with the rest of our team. About VCluster Labs We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture. We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software. We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems. Benefits We offer the following benefits: Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity. Platinum-Level Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country). Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day. Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way. Culture & Values At VCluster Labs, We Value And Stand For: Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms. Compensation Range: €75K - €145K

review_candidates.description: Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection. Reports to: Director of Engineering Location: Toronto, Canada or United States (Remote) About The Role Backcountry is looking for a senior engineer to own the architecture, development, and reliability of the web applications powering our ecommerce business — the customer-facing storefront, the back-office operations platform, and the supporting services that connect them. As Senior Software Engineer, Ecommerce Web Applications , you will work primarily in PHP applications (a Symfony-based storefront and a Laravel back-office platform), shape the front-end experience with JavaScript and CSS, and drive technical direction that the rest of the team builds on. Within your first 6–12 months you will have delivered measurable improvements to system reliability and performance, reduced technical debt in legacy components, established patterns that lift the whole team's delivery velocity, and become a trusted technical leader others turn to. AI coding tools are core to how this team works — you will use AI-assisted development daily, raise the bar for how the team leverages it, and help define the workflows, patterns, and guardrails that make AI-augmented engineering effective and safe. This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility. What You'll Do Drive architecture, hands-on development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support across PHP web applications (a Symfony-based customer storefront and a Laravel back-office platform). Lead front-end direction with JavaScript (including jQuery) and CSS to deliver responsive, accessible, high-performing customer experiences. Champion and evolve the team's AI-assisted development workflows: use AI tools daily, share techniques, and raise the bar for how effectively and responsibly the team uses them. Own the data layer: design and optimize queries and schema interactions against relational databases (SQL Server and PostgreSQL) and supporting services. Set and uphold engineering standards through code review, mentorship, testing practices, and clear technical documentation (design docs, runbooks, onboarding material). Improve reliability, observability, alerting, and incident response for mission-critical, customer-facing systems. Identify opportunities to simplify legacy components, reduce technical debt, and deliver long-term efficiency gains. Break large initiatives into deliverable chunks and clearly communicate status, roadblocks, and dependencies to engineering and product leadership. Partner with Product, QA, and Engineering leadership to ship scalable, user-focused features that elevate business value. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of professional software development experience with a strong ecommerce or high-traffic web application background. Deep, hands-on expertise with PHP, including production experience with Symfony and/or Laravel. Strong front-end skills with JavaScript and CSS, and a solid grasp of web fundamentals (HTTP, browser behavior, performance, accessibility). Strong understanding of relational databases and SQL, including query optimization and schema design. Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining production systems with real end-to-end ownership. Hands-on experience leveraging AI coding tools for development, and the ability to mentor others on using them effectively. This is an AI-development-driven team. Experience with testing practices (unit/integration), Git workflows, and CI/CD. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a track record of mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction. Preferred Qualifications Experience defining or scaling AI-assisted development workflows across a team (agents, prompts, tooling, guardrails). Python experience (Flask or data tooling) for supporting services. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (GCP or AWS). Familiarity with front-end build tools (Webpack / Laravel Mix), package managers (Composer, npm), and templating engines (Blade, Twig). Experience with event-driven or message-based architectures (e.g., RabbitMQ / AMQP). Experience improving observability and monitoring (structured logging, dashboards, tracing). Experience modernizing or incrementally refactoring legacy codebases. Why Join The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work. Cross-Functional Impact: Your work on the storefront and operations platform directly affects how customers shop and how internal teams operate — touching product, QA, and engineering leadership daily. AI-First Skill Building: This is an AI-development-driven team. You will use modern AI coding tools every day and help define the workflows, patterns, and guardrails that make the whole team more effective. End-to-End Ownership: Own architecture decisions, technical direction, and delivery for customer-facing systems. Set the patterns the team builds on and mentor other engineers. Competitive Benefits (United States): We offer an attractive benefits package including primarily remote work, private medical and life insurance, additional paid time off, monthly allowances and reimbursements, employee discounts, and opportunities for professional growth. Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands. Interview Process Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for. Hiring Manager Interview - A deeper conversation with the Manager, MotoSport Technology focused on architecture & ownership, technical leadership / mentorship, and AI-assisted development vision. Technical Discussion Panel - A technical conversation covering Ecommerce system design, PHP/Symfony/Laravel & SQL depth, debugging, and AI-in-practice with an engineering panel. Team Conversation - Discuss c ollaboration, mentorship, code-review judgment, cross-functional communication with team members across functions. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible. In-Person Interview Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate. Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly. Please Note Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately. Due to a high volume of fraudulent applications, you must share a valid LinkedIn profile URL in the application questions below to be considered. If you do not have a LinkedIn profile, you must provide a credible reason in that field and supply alternative evidence of your professional background to verify your identity. $75,000 - $105,000 a year Compensation Shown In USD. The CSC Generation family of brands is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please contact [email protected] . For Ontario applicants, please note that this posting is for an existing vacancy. For US-based candidates, this posting is intended for candidates that reside in the following states: AZ, DE, FL, GA, IN, LA, MI, MS, MO, NV, NC, OK, PA, TN, TX, UT, WV, WI, and WY. CSC Generation will conduct an exhaustive background check including verifying dates of employment directly with your former employer. review_candidates.description: About Ema Ema is building the world’s leading Agentic AI platform to transform enterprise productivity. We enable organizations to delegate repetitive tasks to Ema, the Universal AI Employee, delivering 10x gains in workforce efficiency, across functions. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs. We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production — we ship real systems that run real business processes at scale. The Role You'll be an engineer who builds AI agents in production, sitting close to the customers who depend on them. This is a full-stack engineering job with an unusually short distance between your code and someone's actual workday. You'll write Go and Python, design schemas, build evals, and present your solution to a senior executive at an enterprise - often in the same week. What You'll Do Design and ship production agents. You'll build agents that are mission-critical from day one: embedded in Teams, Slack, intranets, voice lines, and email, taking real actions against SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, and a long tail of systems nobody has heard of. These run at enterprise volume under enterprise scrutiny. Own the full lifecycle. Discovery, build, eval, launch, and the unglamorous months afterward where an agent goes from good to genuinely reliable. Work directly with the people whose problem it is. You'll sit with leaders at global enterprises, extract the process from their heads, and decide what should be an agent, what should be a workflow, and what should stay human. Push your work back into the platform. The best patterns you find in the field become part of Ema's core product - new connectors, new agent primitives, new tooling. You'll surface unmet needs and prototype the fix, working with product and platform engineering to make it general. Example Projects Recent Work By Our Engineers Built the orchestration layer for a 200,000+ employee IT services firm spanning 65 countries, unifying HR, IT, and payroll into a single interface across SAP, ServiceNow, and Teams. Rebuilt a recruiting firm's core stack - sourcing, screening, ranked shortlists - cutting time-to-hire by 67% and retiring their legacy ATS along the way. Cut first-response time from two hours to under 90 seconds for an e-commerce logistics platform, including live carrier-site lookups, and held SLAs through peak holiday volume with no temporary hiring. What You'll Bring Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems, with 5+ years of relevant engineering work Strong backend fundamentals - algorithms, data modeling, and comfort in more than one language, Python and Go especially Proven problem-solving in fast-changing, ambiguous environments where the requirements arrive in a meeting rather than a ticket A builder's mindset and high agency - you find a way to ship rather than waiting for the blocker to clear Comfort working directly with customers Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical audiences alike Even Better You've built or deployed LLM systems in production, and have opinions about evals Familiarity with agent tooling, RAG pipelines, MCP, and prompt engineering as an engineering discipline rather than a trick You've been a founder or founding engineer, and know how to balance craft against speed Experience integrating enterprise applications - HRIS, ITSM, ERP, ticketing - and the authentication that guards them You've worked with distributed, global teams and multi-tenant SaaS environments Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
